instructions.question: What overall feeling does the tweet's author show toward its topic: positive, neutral, or negative?
instructions.rule: Positive includes mild warmth: looking forward to a plan, friendly invitations ('see you there!'), good-luck wishes, excited fan outbursts, holiday fun, tributes to the dead, and news of wins, releases, tours or new products. Neutral is dry information, logistics, commercial ads, plain ticket sales, questions, speculation and calm analysis. Negative needs explicit annoyance, insults, disappointment, worry, personal setbacks, or news of harm or trouble: deaths, attacks, losses, charges, scandals, investigations, protests. Hypothetical sadness, self-mocking stress and ironic exaggeration stay neutral.

neutral.what: Factual updates, logistics, ads, questions, predictions, and opinions without emotional words.
examples: Special Labor Day COOL OUT goes down TOMORROW NIGHT @ the Gin Mill 10-2
Pochettino should have started Alli. He'll probably do a Kane and keep him on the bench till November. Might be too late for him this term
when I go to the Foo Fighters concert in October in Atlanta I'm gonna be so sad if don't get to meet Dave Grohl somehow
neutral.cues: tomorrow night, tickets, specials, ?, should have, may, probably, if
neutral.not_for: Invitations or plans with clear enthusiasm (positive); explicit complaints, insults, or reports of harm or trouble (negative).

positive.what: Any warmth, anticipation, praise, well-wishing or tribute, or good news such as wins, records, releases and launches.
examples: It’s Tuesday night in Athens! AKA karaoke night at the Volstead so come see me!!
Guess who's going to see Foo Fighters on Tuesday!!!!! (ME)
New iPhones, iPad Pro, and Apple TV on the way today at 10 A.M. (PDT)! #AppleEvent
Happy Birthday Wilt Chamberlain may you rest in peace
positive.cues: see you, come see, good luck, can't wait, love, best, awesome, happy, tribute, new album, wins, flailing, OMG, :)
positive.not_for: Dry schedules, ads or ticket listings with no warmth (neutral); 'can't wait' used sarcastically (negative).

negative.what: Anger, sadness, worry, insults, personal disappointment or inconvenience, and news of deaths, attacks, losses, charges, scandals or protests.
examples: Caitlyn Jenner May Face Manslaughter Charge in Malibu Crash I read it on @user #video:
@user so the thing next Thursday isn't free, you'd have to pay $15 to get in since you don't go to UMBC :/ and it ends at 11:30"
negative.cues: sucks, wtf, hate, pity, feel sorry for, not happy, meltdown, nervous, argh, ugh, #fml, crying, :/, :(, killed, charge, problems, investigation, delayed, boo, protest
negative.not_for: Calm arguments, hedged speculation, playful exaggeration, or RIP tributes (neutral or positive).
